description: Mã sự kiện tuân thủ (nhánh kiểm tra, grain = 1 hành vi vi phạm của 1 đối tượng) — PK duy nhất (Bảng Tác nghiệp), thống nhất tên cột PK cho cả 3 nhánh UNION (Admin Penalty/Inspection/Examination). Driving Table: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior (pd_subject_behavior) JOIN Penalty Decision Subject (penalty_decision_subject) — nguồn track draft DataModel/working/Atomic/lld/THANHTRA/lld_THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR.yaml + lld_THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT.yaml, chưa approved.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' WHERE penalty_decision_subject.subject_tp_code = 'ORGANIZATION' -> pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_behavior_code

description: Mã CTCK bị kiểm tra — join Examination Team Target theo định danh (CCCD/ĐKKD) thay vì tên tự do (BA xác nhận 30/07/2026, thay thế join Target_Name = Subject_Name cũ ở O_QLKD_13).
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON (CASE WHEN examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN examination_team_target.citizen_id ELSE examination_team_target.business_registration_nbr END) = penalty_decision_subject.subject_id_nbr AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> examination_team_target.target_reference_id WHERE examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'SECURITIES_COMPANY' -> JOIN securities_company ON securities_company.sc_code = examination_team_target.target_reference_id (Target Reference Id vẫn text/ID thô cross-system — chưa có FK surrogate chính thức
atomic_column: Target Reference Id / Securities Company Code

description: Loại sự kiện tuân thủ — ETL hardcode 'EXAMINATION' cho bộ này.

Loại kiểm tra: PERIODIC=Kiểm tra định kỳ; UNSCHEDULED=Kiểm tra đột xuất. JOIN Examination Team qua Examination Team Target theo định danh (CCCD/ĐKKD, thay thế text match Target Name = Subject Name — xem O_QLKD_13).
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON (CASE WHEN examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN examination_team_target.citizen_id ELSE examination_team_target.business_registration_nbr END) = penalty_decision_subject.subject_id_nbr AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' -> examination_team.form_tp_code
source_attribute: Form Type Code / Subject Id Number

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định kiểm tra. JOIN Examination Team qua Examination Team Target theo định danh (CCCD/ĐKKD).
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON (CASE WHEN examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN examination_team_target.citizen_id ELSE examination_team_target.business_registration_nbr END) = penalty_decision_subject.subject_id_nbr AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' -> examination_team.decision_dt
JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.decision_nbr

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định xử phạt.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.issued_dt

description: Hành vi vi phạm của dòng behavior hiện tại. JOIN Violation Behavior.
etl_logic: JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = pd_subject_behavior.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' -> violation_behavior.violation_behavior_nm

description: Hình thức xử phạt bổ sung — chỉ có giá trị nếu Penalty Type của dòng behavior hiện tại thuộc category SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY, else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm

description: Biện pháp khắc phục — chỉ có giá trị nếu Penalty Type của dòng behavior hiện tại thuộc category REMEDIAL_MEASURE, else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'REMEDIAL_MEASURE' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm

description: Mã hệ thống nguồn dữ liệu.
